activity.notes: Jonathan Lambert established a small settlement on Tristan da Cunha and proclaimed personal sovereignty in 1811, using the Islands of Refreshment name. His project ended with his death in 1812. This records an actual historical settlement and self-proclaimed claim, without implying international recognition or a modern established monarchy.
